question: What is the meaning of warranty start and end date in relation to general information?
description: The warranty start and end date refer to the period during which the manufacturer or authorized representative guarantees the product against defects or failures. This information is typically provided in the general product information section, as specified in Annex IV of the CPR 2024 document. The warranty period can vary depending on the product type and manufacturer, but it usually includes a minimum service life span for declared use (durability) as mentioned in point 1.2(e) of Annex IV. The warranty end date marks the end of the manufacturer's liability for the product, after which the user may need to seek repair or replacement services.
